# CSSKitsune

> Shizen Design System — the Japanese design language for AI-era developers: aesthetic tokens, cultural vocabulary, and copy-paste prompts for authentic Japanese-style UI across web, games, and streaming tools.

CSSKitsune publishes **Shizen** (自然 — naturalness), an open design specification grounded in Japanese aesthetic principles: *ma* (negative space), seasonal palettes, typography rhythm, and motion vocabulary (*en*, *nagare*, *shizuka*). The interactive Prompt Builder covers five aesthetic packs (Wabi-Sabi, Shinto Ceremonial, Edo Ink, Sakura Season, Yoru) and seven platforms (Cursor/Claude, v0, Figma, Webflow, OBS, Godot, Defold). Specification, tokens, and prompts are licensed CC BY 4.0.

Full catalog (all yokai themes, every page): see https://csskitsune.com/llms-full.txt

## Core

- [Home](https://csskitsune.com/): Landing hub — explore Shizen, the Kitsune theme maker, prompt builder, and guides.
- [Shizen Prompt Builder](https://csskitsune.com/prompt-builder.php): Pick platform, aesthetic, season, and mood → ready-to-paste AI prompt with live aesthetic preview.
- [Shizen Design System v1.0 — Specification](https://csskitsune.com/spec.php): Open spec for color tokens, ma-based spacing, typography, motion vocabulary, and naming. CC BY 4.0.
- [Japanese UI Design Principles Guide](https://csskitsune.com/guide.php): How ma, wabi-sabi, and kisetsukan translate into UI and CSS, with links to tokens and prompts.
- [Free Wabi-Sabi Prompt Pack](https://csskitsune.com/prompt-pack-wabi-sabi.php): One palette, one prompt — tokens, spacing, print- or PDF-friendly lead magnet.

## Theme Makers

- [Kitsune Web — Theme Maker](https://csskitsune.com/kitsune/): Fox-spirit palette, live CSS variable generator, and kitsune website aesthetics.
- [Yokai CSS Themes](https://csskitsune.com/yokai/): Hub for 20 spirit-inspired CSS palettes — each with tokens, typography, and links to folklore on JapaneseMythicalCreatures.com.

## Platform Prompts

- [Cursor / Claude / ChatGPT Prompts](https://csskitsune.com/cursor-prompts.php): Copy-paste prompt for Japanese minimal UI in Cursor and LLM coding tools.
- [Webflow Prompts](https://csskitsune.com/webflow-prompts.php): AI prompts and CSS custom properties for Japanese minimal UI in Webflow.
- [OBS Overlay Prompts](https://csskitsune.com/obs-prompts.php): Browser-source-ready prompts and CSS for Japanese stream aesthetics.
- [Godot UI Theming](https://csskitsune.com/godot-theming.php): Shizen tokens and palettes for Godot 4 theme resources.
- [Defold GUI Styling](https://csskitsune.com/defold-styling.php): Shizen color and spacing tokens for Defold GUI with AI prompts.

## Optional

- [HTML Sitemap](https://csskitsune.com/site-map.php): Human-readable page index.
